maya: Hey team 15m sync. Need final micro-variants for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing heroes + subheads, 1-line social benchmark teaser (no raw numbers), webinar reg routing rules. Handoff by EOD tomorrow.

ryan: Quick tone call: Hosted = punchy PLG, Dedicated = results & predictability, Private = compliance-first. Keep CTAs 2-3 words.

katie: Draft heroes (short) + subheads + CTA
- Hosted: "Start with Redwood Hosted"  "Fast to launch, built for scale."  "Start free"
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity"  "Throughput you can bank on."  "Reserve capacity"
- Private: "Private deployment options"  "VPC, KMS, and on-prem for regulated apps."  "Request a demo"

dev: Small tweak: Hosted CTA -> "Try Hosted" (more action). Dedicated subhead shorten to "Predictable throughput." Private hero shorten to "Private deployments for compliance."

ryan: Social benchmark teaser options (pick one):
- "Join our webinar: independent latency & cost comparisons across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private."
- "Live demo + benchmark walkthrough  see how different deployment modes perform."
- "Benchmarks + demo  30min event, register to watch."

maya: Webinar format: 30m product demo, 15m benchmark walkthrough, 15m live Q&A. Reg page needs primary CTA (Register) + secondary (Send to AE for Dedicated/Private). Also capture utm params.

dev: HubSpot routing snippet (will implement):
```
if form.type == "hosted_trial": assign.lifecycle = "MQL"; owner = "marketing"; add.hidden.utm_campaign = "launch_webinar";
if form.type == "dedicated_interest": assign.owner = "AE_pool"; tag = "dedicated_lead"; notify = "sales@redwood";
if form.type == "private_contact": assign.owner = "Enterprise_SDR"; priority = "high"; notify = "sales-enterprise@redwood";
```
I'll post workflow IDs once active.

katie: Also adding microcopy for the registration confirmation email: "Thanks for registering. Add to calendar + watch live demo & benchmark. If you're interested in Dedicated or Private, reply and we'll connect you to an AE."

hubot: Reminder: calendar created  Webinar: "Deployment modes: demo + benchmarks" on 2025-05-14T15:00Z. Speakers: @maya @katie @dev :calendar:

maya: Perfect. Ryan  pick one social teaser and format for LinkedIn + X. Dev  drop workflow IDs when done. Katie  make 3 micro-variants each and drop into the launch doc by EOD. Thanks :rocket:
